title: Gabriel Dropout
label: Quick read (from summaries)
premise: Angels graduating from school in heaven are sent to Earth to learn about humans and guide them. Gabriel White Tenma, top of her class, gets hooked on online games and becomes a lazy slob, while her best friend Vignette, a demon, turns out to be the responsible one. A gag comedy about angels and demons attending a Japanese high school.
life_message: Kindness and friendship matter more than labels; the angel can be lazy and the demon good-hearted.

content.note: Light girls'-love subtext played for comedy (MU tags); MangaDex suggestive.
Game addiction and shut-in habits, played for laughs (Wikipedia; AniList Hikikomori).
Online gaming, spending on games and otaku culture are central jokes (Wikipedia; AniList Otaku Culture).

dominant: Role-reversal comedy; friendship across angel and demon; slacker humor
